description: Use this when an actor needs an original two-person script for scene practice, cold reading, line memorization or selftape preparation, including when they have no scene partner. Returns published scenes and roles in the requested language. Read a chosen scene with get_practice_scene before offering its app link. Do not use to find private audition sides, monologues or an organization's repertoire; this tool does not provide a live reader inside this chat. In the blablabla app, the other part is read aloud.

locale.description: Script language, for example en or da. Pass the explicitly requested script language, otherwise the conversation language. Carry the same locale through listing, reading and setup. English is a legacy default only when omitted. Unpublished versions return an error, never a translation.

name: list_practice_scenes
title: Find two-person practice scenes
